# GitHub Discussions Configuration

## Categories

### 💬 General
- General discussions about CoinBalance
- Questions and answers
- Community announcements
- Off-topic discussions

### 💡 Ideas
- Feature requests
- Improvement suggestions
- Architecture discussions
- Innovation ideas

### 🐛 Q&A
- Technical questions
- Troubleshooting
- How-to guides
- Best practices

### 🎉 Show and Tell
- Project showcases
- Success stories
- Community highlights
- User experiences

### 📢 Announcements
- Release announcements
- Important updates
- Community events
- Official communications

## Guidelines

### ✅ Do
- Be respectful and inclusive
- Search before posting
- Use descriptive titles
- Provide context and details
- Help others when you can

### ❌ Don't
- Spam or self-promote excessively
- Post duplicate content
- Use inappropriate language
- Share sensitive information
- Violate our Code of Conduct

## Getting Started

1. **Search**: Check if your question has been asked before
2. **Choose Category**: Select the most appropriate category
3. **Write Clearly**: Use descriptive titles and provide context
4. **Be Patient**: Give others time to respond
5. **Follow Up**: Respond to answers and mark solutions
